original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军方在博尔诺州普尔卡社区附近空袭打死15名恐怖分子
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚军方称，在博尔诺州格沃扎地方政府区普尔卡西北方向实施精确空袭，打死15名恐怖分子。军方表示，此次行动于10月23日深夜约11时50分进行，依据情报报告及对疑似恐怖分子活动的确认目击。行动由“哈丁凯行动”联合特遣部队（东北）执行，空袭后还开展了地面行动。军方未透露被打死的嫌疑人身份，也未说明是否有军人或平民受到影响。

location.raw_text: north-west of Pulka in Gwoza Local Government Area of Borno State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚军方称在博尔诺州普尔卡西北方向空袭打死15名恐怖分子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigerian military has reported that 15 terrorists were neutralised in a precision air strike north-west of Pulka in Gwoza Local Government Area of Borno State.

key_facts.fact: 行动于10月23日深夜约11时50分进行，依据情报报告及对疑似恐怖分子活动的确认目击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The operation was carried out at about 11:50pm on Friday, October 23, following intelligence reports and confirmed sightings of suspected terrorist movements in the area.

key_facts.fact: 空袭后开展了地面行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the air strike was followed by ground operations aimed at exploiting the area and consolidating the gains recorded during the offensive

key_facts.fact: 军方未透露被打死的嫌疑人身份，也未说明是否有军人或平民受到影响
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The military did not provide further details about the identities of the 15 suspected terrorists or disclose whether any military personnel or civilians were affected during the operation.

uncertainties: 被打死的15人身份尚未公布
是否有军人或平民在行动中受影响尚未说明
事件目前仅有一个来源（Sahara Reporters）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
